RunEndToEnd._comment: MeanNs/AllocatedBytes are BenchmarkDotNet's iteration mean/cumulative-allocation figures — these two fields are what compare-benchmarks.ps1 gates on. PeakWorkingSetBytes below is a reference-only figure from a separate single-shot Process.PeakWorkingSet64 probe (not gated); it reflects actual resident memory, which is far lower than AllocatedBytes because that field counts cumulative GC churn, not live memory.
